title: vtc-00: no cross-account model
description: Bob's call lives in bob-account, but Alice answers in alice-account (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:1813) by updating a record created by Bob's call, and VTCCallPush pairs alice-account with Bob's callId (:1281). Which account holds a call for each user is undefined. Related: jmap-chat-spec-jlsm.3, jmap-chat-spec-k0pv.5.
close_reason: Shared hosting-account model added to vtc-00/vtc-wss (Hosting Account section); examples use the hosting account.
